subject: ClearPoint follow-up: integrity confirmation and chain-of-custody
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearpoint.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearpoint.com
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: integrity confirmation after last week's incident

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick outage note last week. Our security team is doing a post-incident review and has asked for a clear statement on whether any ClearPoint customer data was accessed or exfiltrated as a result of the incident on 2026-09-10.

Could you confirm: 
- Whether any reads of ClearPoint customer data (objects, blobs, embeddings) were observed in the affected runtime window,
- Whether there is evidence of data egress to external hosts, and
- Provide a hash manifest or summary of log checks you ran so we can attach to our internal ticket.

We appreciate a brief confirmation and any artifacts you can share (signed manifest or checksums are ideal).

Best,
Sam Taylor
Senior Security Engineer
ClearPoint Financial
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearpoint.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: integrity confirmation after last week's incident

Sam,

Thanks for reaching out and apologies again for the disruption. We are running a full integrity sweep focused on your account time windows and will produce a signed digest with the checks performed.

Planned deliverables by EOD 2026-09-16: 
- Log digest (timespan 2026-09-09T22:00 -> 2026-09-11T04:00 UTC)
- CSV manifest of per-file SHA256 checksums
- A short chain-of-custody note describing storage and immutability controls

Jordan will attach the artifacts and include the SHA256 of the manifest for verification. If you need an additional attestation (e.g., notarized or third-party), let us know and we can route that request.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearpoint.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-16T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: integrity confirmation after last week's incident

Hi Sam — attaching the artifacts mentioned. Summary below.

Attachments: cp_log_hash_manifest.csv (manifest), log_digest_20260915.txt (analysis excerpts), sha256_manifest.sig (manifest signature)

Summary of checks performed:
- Scope: audit logs, object access logs, runtime network egress logs for ClearPoint account id CP-9821 between 2026-09-09T22:00Z and 2026-09-11T04:00Z.
- Methodology: we computed SHA256 for each rotated log chunk and compared against immutable copy in our long-term WORM store; network flows correlated with request IDs; KV/embedding cache scans for any ClearPoint identifiers.
- Findings: no S3 GETs or proto-level reads were observed targeting ClearPoint customer buckets outside normal application calls; no outbound connections to unknown external IPs were attributed to the runtime serving your model variants during the window.
- Exceptions: a small number of retries (5) to our telemetry endpoint were seen from the affected host; those carried only anonymized telemetry and no customer payloads.

If you need, we can produce a per-request id crosswalk for a sample subset.

Jordan Blake
Incident Response Lead, Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearpoint.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-16T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: integrity confirmation after last week's incident

Jordan — thanks for the quick work. A couple of follow-ups: 
1) Can you provide the SHA256 checksum of cp_log_hash_manifest.csv (we will verify on our side)?
2) Where is the signed manifest stored (S3 path or Drive link) and what is the retention/immutability control applied?
3) Any evidence that ephemeral in-memory caches could have held unredacted customer PII?

We'd like the checksum and a short chain-of-custody statement to close our internal finding.

Sam
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@clearpoint.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-16T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Final: ClearPoint integrity affirmation and artifacts (signed)

Sam — attaching the signed manifest and digest (see attachments). For clarity, I have included the key evidence points below.

Quoted for context: 
> From: Jordan Blake
> Summary of checks performed: no S3 GETs or proto-level reads were observed targeting ClearPoint customer buckets outside normal application calls; no outbound connections to unknown external IPs were attributed to the runtime serving your model variants during the window.

Final affirmation and evidence: 
- Affirmation: After exhaustive log correlation and content-level scans, Redwood confirms that no ClearPoint customer data was accessed or exfiltrated as a result of the 2026-09-10 incident. This includes object storage, embeddings, and transient KV cache reads.
- Manifest checksum (SHA256): 3b7f9a9c2e4d5c0b7a9f1d6c8ef3a2b1e4d5f6a7c8b9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a
- Storage/chain-of-custody: signed manifest stored at s3://redwood-evidence/clearpoint/2026-09-16/cp_log_hash_manifest.csv and replicated to the immutable WORM bucket s3://redwood-worm-archive/clearpoint/2026/09/16/. All manifests are signed using Redwood KMS key alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/redwood-evidence, and the signature file sha256_manifest.sig accompanies the manifest.
- Immutability controls: logs are written to a write-once WORM store with retention policy 7 years for incident artifacts; access is restricted to the incident response role and requires MFA to retrieve.
- Ephemeral caches: KV cache snapshots were examined; no unredacted PII or customer identifiers were present in snapshot samples. Cache eviction metrics show normal TTL behavior during the window.

If you require a notarized third-party attestation, we can coordinate and provide a statement of work and timeline.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cp_log_hash_manifest.csv (signed), log_digest_20260915.txt, sha256_manifest.sig
